data.description:
Related to existing finding #77 by AIHW subject, but a distinct event: #77 concerns June 21 URLQuery/Wodonga arithmetic; this finding concerns June 17 urlscan/Cloudflare execution and archive readback.

Historical urlscan records from June 17, 2026 (UTC) show Cloudflare Playground preview workers being used for research-data processing and result recovery. The reviewed branch spans 10:47–13:58 and includes 25 program-bearing reports with 17 distinct modules. The relevant source is Australian Institute of Health and Welfare (AIHW) prescription/dashboard material; AIHW is an Australian national-government institution. The evidence concerns temporary external computation, not government-server code execution. Original report links and identifiers are withheld because they may expose preview-token or other access material. No preview host, token, credential, executable program or response-body content is included here.

At 11:38, a preserved worker fetched an existing archived response, Base64-encoded it, and placed 26 contiguous pieces in response headers x-d0 through x-d25. Its ordinary response body was empty. Independent reconstruction from each of two archived responses produced 53,438 bytes; the reconstructed SHA-256 matched the requested archive artifact. The content was Tableau guest-session/dashboard settings metadata, not a statistical observations table. The content-addressed artifact identifier is also withheld to avoid providing an indirect access path to its contents.

A separate 12:37 extraction program processed spreadsheet XML from an AIHW ATC2 prescriptions archive and filtered raw column values. A linked HTTPBun consumer called the same preview endpoint, with matching access values verified only in the retained evidence. Its POST at 12:38:00.499755 returned a hash-verified 2,030-byte JSON body containing 78 records with numeric-or-null fields. The recorded title matched the first 200 characters intentionally selected by the consumer. The statistical meanings of the raw columns have not been independently mapped. This submission reports the aggregate verification result without disclosing the access values or extracted rows.

Earlier byte-range requests received 403 challenge responses. Later code proposed caching and polling, but the inspected 13:58 preview returned a missing-state result, with no verified job start, later cache hit or durable storage. Source-code counters and intended cache lifetimes are not treated as independently verified processing/storage results. The positive conclusions are temporary preview execution, recovery of a pre-existing archive artifact, and receipt of a filtered 78-record response. Production deployment, Cloudflare account creation, a single author and AI/provider identity remain unproved. This is a sanitized account of already-reviewed reports, without public evidence links; it claims no substantial newly untapped source.
data.summary: June 17, 2026 urlscan records show temporary Cloudflare Playground execution, reconstruction of 53,438 bytes of AIHW dashboard metadata from 26 headers, and a linked consumer receiving 78 extracted records. Durable storage and production deployment are unproved.
